text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, shortly after Shinko Windy advanced to the Classic Class...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Hey, isn't that Shinko Windy over there?
The one from the academy's official dirt promo video...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, did you hear that?
Allllriiiight...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Raaaawr!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wah-hah-hah-hah-hah!
It is I, the great Shinko Windy-chan!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Amazing, it's the real deal! A real bad girl!
I always watch your Umatter too!
I love the prank videos you pull on your trainer!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huuuuh? Really?
Do you truly like it that much?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Yes, I check your latest posts right away! Please shake my hand if you don't mind—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Shinko Windy is steadily gaining fans and earning recognition from the public.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her legs have developed solidly as well,
so there seems to be no further risk of shin splints.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was about time for her to start racing in earnest.
When I brought this up to Shinko Windy...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, finally, huh?!
Windy-chan's popularity has shot up, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ghehehe~~!
It's finally time to raid the racing world, babyyy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As we considered the race rotation,
there was something I wanted to confirm once more.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh, absolutely! It means committing every evil deed imaginable in races and striking fear into the whole wide world!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gahahaha! I'm gonna stand out bigger and bolder than anyone,
and keep everyone's eyes glued
right on Windy-chan~~~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Still... you have a point... Hmmm.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan wants to stand out forever. Not just for a split second!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"While Windy-chan's been gaining fans,
she realized something."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "Videos and Umatter trends only stay popular for a teeny-tiny bit!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Even when you think, 'It went viral!',
after two or three days, no one's even talking about it anymore."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Once everyone checks it out once, it's over...
They stop paying attention to Windy-chan.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand besides! Whenever something happens on the turf,
everyone's attention goes right over there!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It pisses me off! Windy-chan wants
to be in the spotlight all, aaall the time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Through her irritation, I felt as though I could glimpse the 'thing she truly wanted,' which she herself hadn't realized..."
choice_data_list: When you say 'forever,' how long is that?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That's, like, foreeeeeeeever!
Even after you retire, even when you're an old grandma,
everyoooone's gonna be watching and gossiping about you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Something like, "There was this crazy beast on the dirt track!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you see something new, it feels like it just makes you remember nightmares, like:
'Man, remember back when Shinko Windy did that~?'

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Even if years, decades,
or a hundred years pass!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: History...?
choice_data_list: Oh yeah, take a look at this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I took a book from the shelf and handed it over.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What's this about? Let's see...
"Fan-Voted All-Time Strongest Umamusume Rankings"?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I know this one, nodaa.
And I've heard of this one, and this one too...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Basically, they're super amazing guys that everybody knows.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
choice_data_list: Being in the spotlight all the time...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right, nod!
Windy-chan wants to be featured in something like this too, nod!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Minion! How do I get featured in this!?
choice_data_list: Get stronger and you'll get featured.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...If I... get stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Then it's easy-peasy.
Windy-chan is already super strong,
so I just gotta make 'em understand that!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy-chan has decided.
I'm gonna win and win and win a whole bunch,
and get featured in stuff like this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make 1st through 100th place
aaaall Windy-chan, just you waaaatch!
choice_data_list: That's not quite what I meant, but...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: “Still, isn't this the first time she's shown such motivation?”

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Windy-chan, Windy-chan is—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
“Talked about 100 years from now
as the top of the all-time strongest Umamusume rankings”...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna become that kind of Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It is my new "ambition"------!!
Uooooooohhh---!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few minutes later, having calmed down,
Shinko Windy asked me a question.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: So, what exactly should we do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, I suggested, why not aim for a graded race
like the Unicorn Stakes?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's the same distance and racecourse as her debut race,
so with that experience under her belt, it should be an easier run.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see...? Well, that works for me then!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'll leave the difficult stuff to you, my strategist!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh! The first step in Windy-chan's grand ambition is to CHOMP the Unicorn! That's how it goes~!
